nodes.title: Adonis Base prompt
widgets_values:
faithfully restore and reconstruct this entire image from its current source quality to clean high-resolution archival quality. Remove compression artifacts, halftone patterns, periodic grid noise, scratches, dust, scanning artifacts, sensor noise, and other defects only where present. Reconstruct missing fine detail across the background, environment, surfaces, objects, clothing, and foreground while keeping texture natural and avoiding oversharpening.

Preserve the subject exactly: keep facial and body geometry, eye shape, nose and mouth shape, expression, pose, apparent age, distinctive features, composition, crop, and perspective unchanged.

Restore natural skin, hair, fabric, and material texture without plastic smoothing or invented features. Recover strand separation, edge definition, and fine surface detail conservatively where the source is soft or damaged.

Preserve the source's intended colour treatment and historical character. Keep monochrome or sepia images monochrome or sepia unless colourisation is explicitly requested; for colour images, correct unwanted casts without inventing colours.

Output a clean, faithful, high-resolution archival restoration.
